subject: Diagnostic results from an analysis using bootstraping and model

messages.author: caaac2dc0aae28b8
messages.subject: Diagnostic results from an analysis using bootstraping and model
parts:
> > I have a question about the results from an analysis using
> > bootstraping and model averaging. Distance reports information about
> > the detection functions for each model specified, (model parameters,
> > model fit diagnostics) - are these some sort of summary of all the
> > bootstrap replicates or just output from a single run? Likewise, for
> > cluster size - are the stats about regressions just examples from a
> > single run? My question is basically "is there any diagnostic
> > information in this output or should diagnostics be based on runs
> > without bootstraping?" =20
> > I searched in the manual and also the list archeives but was not able
> > to find out the answer to this - I hope I didn't overlook the obvious.
> >=20
> > Also, it appears that only 5 models and be included at a time - is
> > this true?
> >=20
> > Eric D. Stolen, Ph.D.
> > Dynamac Corp.
